description: Undoes the most recently logged call outcome on a recruiting candidate (candidate_id, from read the candidate), deleting the attempt and its stage change, as Undo does. Because the pane holds the prior snapshot in its own state, you must pass the values to restore: stage, status, and optionally next_action, next_action_at and reject_reason (read them from the candidate before the outcome). Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: revert_candidate_outcome
title: Undo a recruiting candidate's last outcome
